name: [⌛24H!] Save Brainrots From Tornado!
desc:
🌪️ Welcome to Save Brainrots From Tornado!

👍 Like & ⭐ favorite the game for FREE OP BRAINROT! ✨

⚡ Grab Brainrots before the tornado sucks you up!
💸 The farther you go, the rarer Brainrots you’ll find!
🏃 Spend your cash on speed upgrades to escape faster!
🏠 Upgrade your base to unlock more Brainrot slots!
🔁 Use rebirths to multiply your money and climb the leaderboards!

🧠 Your Brainrots earn offline! - keep growing even when you’re away! Return every 24 hours to claim your rewards and keep the earnings flowing! 💰
